name: Asking For Money
overview: Scripture teaches that wealth and the ability to acquire it come from the LORD, who empowers His people to prosper as part of His covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 8:18). Believers are called to honor God with their possessions and to give generously to those in need without reluctance (Proverbs 3:9; Matthew 5:42). True righteousness includes practicing just and honest dealings, avoiding exploitation such as usury (Ezekiel 18:8). Ultimately, seeking God's kingdom and righteousness is paramount, with the promise that all necessary things will be provided (Matthew 6:33), as exemplified by Jesus observing the sincere giving of even the poor at the temple treasury (Mark 12:41).
